style: O Segredo de Varginha: top-down pixel art, dark outlines, existing character proportions, crisp nearest-neighbour rendering.

assets.name: EntityManifestation
assets.designBrief: Large hostile manifestation of the wounded entity before its peaceful return. Preserve the game's extraterrestrial silhouette and amber eyes. Four directions, eight poses per direction: movement, anticipation, lunge, recovery. Transparent background, complete silhouettes, no lettering or floor shadow.
assets.processing: Detected complete connected bodies, padded 128x144 cells, eight columns and four rows. Threshold alpha only; nearest-neighbour scaling. Main boss 34 pixels per unit; miniature echoes 100 pixels per unit. Same design, visibly different size.

assets.name: SupportAttacks
assets.designBrief: Existing Renan with glasses, beard, plaid shirt and notebook emits orange interference. Existing older Ouzana with dark skin, curly black hair, glasses and lab coat throws a green reagent flask. Preserve the existing bald, grey-bearded priest design for a golden protection aura. Anticipation, emission/contact and recovery to west and east; transparent sheet without captions.
assets.processing: Six 128x128 cells per row; three rows. Existing character identities retained; alpha threshold and nearest-neighbour packing.

assets.name: SupportEffects
assets.designBrief: Detached animated pixel effects: green reagent flask, splash and lingering cloud; expanding orange notebook pulse and cyan electronic interference; golden protection dome with crosses and fading sparks. Transparent background, six frames per effect, no characters or text.
assets.processing: Three rows of six 128x128 effect frames. Timed flight, impact, lingering damage, interference stagger and bounded protection are implemented separately in gameplay.

assets.name: FinalBattleArena
assets.designBrief: Large underground containment arena consistent with the existing stone-and-industrial maps. Broad unobstructed central floor for Edelzio, nine students, three adult allies, a large entity and small echoes. Tree, river and chapel stations, pipes, lamps, north containment passage and south entrance. No legends, collision markings, labels or explanatory panels.
assets.processing: 1536x1024 map reused by battle 20 and peaceful return 21; JSON collider/interaction layout and brighter arena-only lighting.

assets.name: Memory1898
assets.designBrief: First-person memory from 1898: anonymous hands and linen sleeves at a brass valve and mechanical lever in a stone basement, containment door and warm amber illumination. Historical equipment, no modern electronics or labels.
assets.processing: Source retained in ArtSources; Point import and full-screen memory presentation after the archive puzzle.

studentAttacks: The superseded shared student sheet is retained only as an art source. Runtime uses each student's two separate authored attack atlases and effect atlases, documented in Students20261004/REFERENCIAS_E_PROMPTS.json. Personal photos are excluded.
